x: This was a day of fine performances in the claret and gold for our fifth man home was Trevor Luck, not yet eligible for the team and therefore walking as an individual.
Syd James and Hugh McGreechan finished together in 1h. 44m. and Len Demmon and Trevor Luck certainly walked well. Harry Shields, with an allowance of 12 minutes, won the handicap.
Trevor Luck, our only other competitor, walked very well to get inside 60 minutes and thus gain his 7 miles in the hour badge. At Imber Court in January he just missed it by one second.

Terry Clark won this trophy in the very good time of 40m.04s. with Trevor Luck 2nd in 41.07 and Nick Milsum 3rd in 41.24. Although it is difficult to get a big field for this race as it coincides with the age for National Service, I hope there will be a few more next year.

Ray Middleton, home from Ireland, walked well to finish 6th in 41m.21s., Dave Stevens (individual) was 7th, Nick Milsum 9th and Terry Clark, who walked a blinder on the last lap, was 12th and Trevor Luck 13th.

We had expected Trevor Luck to take a forward position in this year's race but he unfortunately broke a wrist a fortnight earlier, thus belying his name, and must wait another year.
